concerns.text: FR-002's conditional first half — 'MUST download a dedicated binary black hole population synthesis catalog ... from a configured community repository. If no verified external source exists, ... generate' — has no task. T003 implements only the synthetic-generation fallback; no task attempts the download path or records the source-verification decision that justifies falling back. Add a task (or extend T003) to attempt/verify an external catalog and document why generation was chosen.

FR-011 and SC-004/005/006 (runtime ≤6h, memory ≤7GB, disk ≤20GB) have no task that MEASURES these quantities. T011 only documents 'resource expectations'; the claim that constraints are 'validated by the platform runner, not by project-written CI files' is not a verification step any task executes. Add a task to record measured runtime/peak-memory/peak-disk from a real run into an artifact (e.g., data/results/resource_usage.json) so SC-004–006 are checkable.

The plan's testing section specifies an integration test 'tests/integration/test_pipeline.py' for pipeline flow, but no task creates any integration test (only unit tests per module). Either add a task for the end-to-end integration test or note its deliberate omission.
